body.represents: A basket of listed electricity generation companies, issued as a token on Solana.
economicRights: No voting rights over the underlying shares.
limitations: It is a tokenized product, not direct ownership of the shares.

risks: Power prices and regulation can change quickly.

costs: Platform fee of about 0.05% per swap.
body.howToTrade: Swap USDC for PWR-E and back, through a route the app finds when you review each operation.
eligibilityNotes: May not be available in some regions.
